This step searched for a code shape that spans lines. Use ast-grep, free, before more text searches or hand edits: matches and rewrites code by syntax tree, so strings and comments are ignored and a match can span lines. Run `{command}` in your shell with `--pattern '<pattern>'` and the paths, and read its JSON.

This step ran a dead-code tool that is no longer maintained. Use knip, free, instead: finds unused files, exports and dependencies through the whole module graph. Run `{command}` in your shell from the project root, and read its JSON.

This step failed with an access before initialization, which an import cycle can cause. Use dependency-cruiser, free, before tracing imports by hand: finds import cycles and what depends on a module. Run `{command}` in your shell with the source folder and `--ts-pre-compilation-deps`, and read its JSON.

This step packed a package. Use attw, free, before you publish: checks that the package's types resolve under node10, node16 and bundlers, for ESM and CJS. Run `{command}` in your shell from the package folder after it is built, and read its JSON.
